fixtures: controlComp('biscuit', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / biscuit / helm (fixed B3). The fixed B3 is mandatory: without it the comp makes ZERO Full Bursts and the whole S1 line (fullBurstEnd) becomes unobservable. Six counterfactual comps reuse the same fixture with an in-memory biscuit override patched BY PREDICATE (locate the buff effect carrying the kit magnitude 5.77 / 43.08 and mutate its block in place): target->{allies} for each of the two buffs, value amplification for each, durationSec 10->60 on the burst ATK, and skill2 blocks emptied. Predicate patching also makes the file shape-agnostic (a slot holding Block[] or {blocks: Block[]} both work). 7 runs total. TWO fixture risks are called out and isolated into their own named tests so a fixture failure is not misread as a model divergence: (1) biscuit is Burst II and shares the stage with crown, so her burst casts only on rotations where crown is on cooldown; (2) S1 targets Attacker allies, and the control comp's class composition is not asserted anywhere in the packet — if neither crown nor helm is an Attacker, the S1 line has no observable target in this comp. The class-scope proof is therefore carried by the {allies} counterfactual (strictly-more-applies), which holds regardless of which teammates are Attackers.
